description.en: South Carolina is a state in the Southeastern, South Atlantic and Deep South regions of the United States. It borders North Carolina to the north and northeast, the Atlantic Ocean to the southeast, and Georgia to the west and south across the Savannah River.
description.zh-CN: 南卡羅來納州是美國東南部地區的一個美國州份。它北鄰北卡羅來納州，東南臨大西洋，西部與南部隔著薩凡納河與喬治亞州相望。
